tagline: Empowering people to protect and connect what matters most
hero_kpi_rationale: RMR measures the volume of recurring revenue under contract at a given point in time, enabling forecasting of future revenue performance as the majority comes from recurring sources.

kpis.name: Recurring Monthly Revenue at Period End
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from recurring monitoring fees and other recurring services
kpis.description: RMR measures the volume of contractual revenue at a given point in time and is useful for forecasting future revenue performance

kpis.name: Gross Customer Revenue Attrition Rate
kpis.explanation: RMR lost due to customer attrition, net of dealer rebills and reactivated customers
kpis.description: Gross customer revenue attrition evaluates customer retention and satisfaction performance. A 1% change represents approximately $40 million impact on annualized recurring revenue.
kpis.signal: Indicator of customer loyalty and subscriber trends

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company acknowledges that competition impacts demand for its offerings, particularly due to acquisition, disposition, or discontinuation of similar activities by competitors, influencing pricing and quality of offered services.

risks.title: Customer Attrition
risks.score_rationale: Customer attrition has a direct impact on revenue. A 1% change in attrition represents approximately $40 million annualized impact on recurring revenue. In 2024, gross customer revenue attrition was 13.1%, an increase of 0.4 point compared to 12.7% in 2023.

risks.title: Inflation
risks.score_rationale: The company notes that inflation may impact its operating costs, particularly due to rising prices of raw materials and labor.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: As a provider of security and smart home solutions, ADT faces significant cybersecurity risks related to the protection of customer data and systems, particularly critical for customer trust.

risks.title: Technological Dependence
risks.score_rationale: ADT is highly dependent on technological advancements and its transition toward a software-centric model based on the ADT+ platform, requiring continuous investment in development and infrastructure.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a regulated industry and must comply with various legal and data protection requirements, particularly for security monitoring.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The availability of components and equipment is critical for delivering ADT's security and smart home solutions, affecting the ability to serve customers.

ai_positioning.summary: ADT positions AI as a central element of its future strategic vision, particularly in its always-on, always-ready protection powered by artificial intelligence in collaboration with its expert team, and in its evolution toward a software-centric model based on the ADT+ platform integrating ambient sensing capabilities.
evidence: Vision to deliver always-on, always-ready protection powered by artificial intelligence and expert team
ADT+ platform designed as foundational ecosystem integrating human expertise with ambient sensing capabilities
Transition toward a software-as-a-product model centered on the platform for professionally installed and self-installed solutions
